construct: a stack that MIXES a drop layer with an `inset` hairline — astryx `shadow-med`'s third layer, the 1px inner ring every menu card and toast carries
why: THE PINNED WALL for the mixed stack. The emitter DOES lower it: the node holds [DROP_SHADOW, INNER_SHADOW] (verifiable in the round trip's own naming quote). The INVERSION is what stops — core/propose-figma.ts:2814 proposes a box-shadow only when every layer is a DROP_SHADOW, because core/propose-figma.ts's shadowCss has no `inset` spelling and serializing an inner shadow as a drop one would be a wrong answer, not a lost one. This case pins that refusal by name so the canvas→code half cannot quietly start guessing, and so the RC3 ink fix is never confused with closing it. Deliberately NOT declared mustDraw: the ink reaches the canvas, the read-back does not, and those are different rounds.

canvas.note: the node carries DROP_SHADOW + INNER_SHADOW; the inversion NAMES the mixed stack rather than proposing a box-shadow it would have to spell wrong (core/propose-figma.ts:2840)
